name: Lago
long_description:
At Lago, we're on a mission to make billing simpler, more transparent, and more adaptable for SaaS companies.

As the leading open-source billing platform, we empower businesses to build flexible pricing models and scale with confidence. We've raised over $22 million in funding from top-tier investors including Y Combinator and FirstMark, reflecting strong confidence in our vision and growth.

Our platform has garnered over 9,000 stars on GitHub, a testament to our active and growing developer community. Companies such as PayPal, Synthesia and Mistral.ai choose Lago for their billing.

We're a team of ambitious, focused individuals who work together to solve hard problems with excellence and accountability. At Lago, we value reliability and proactivity - we trust each other to own tasks, drive them to completion, and adapt quickly. While we encourage you to try fast and "fail fast", we also expect you to learn fast: make mistakes, but don't make the same one twice.

If you're excited by challenges and want to grow alongside a high-performing, supportive team, this is the place for you.

name: Health Harbor
long_description:
We use generative AI to call insurance on behalf of healthcare clinics. We save clinics up to 40 hours of calls every week over existing outsourced human solutions. 

Compared to the existing solutions for benefits verifications: 
- We're faster -- by default, we have a turnaround of 24 hours compared to typically a 3 day turnaround for competitors
- We can reach more payors -- as long as they have a phone line, we can support calling them for benefits. There's quite a few payors in both medical and dental (e.g. Seledent) that have yet to offer a digital retrieval of benefits

launches.title: Health Harbor - Automated billing for private medical practices
launches.body:
### **Hey everyone! We are Nathan, Alan, and Gloria from Health Harbor.**

**TL;DR:** Private practices spend hours every week talking with insurance trying to determine fee coverage so patients don't end up with a surprise bill. Health Harbor uses AI to automate billing for private practices by having an AI call insurance on their behalf. Check us out: [https://healthharbor.co](https://healthharbor.co/)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73410&key=user_uploads/1322783/392081ad-49f0-4086-a585-4d1df7292820)

### **The Problem**

Imagine spending almost 100 million hours on the phone with medical insurance. Trust us, medical providers can. Over 230,000 private practices in the US spend more than 8 hours every week sitting on the line with insurance trying to determine the amount insurance will cover.

### **The Solution**

Health Harbor relieves doctors’ offices from needing to call insurance. Instead they can simply submit requests through Health Harbor’s HIPAA certified portal.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73410&key=user_uploads/1322783/81fa57fd-de79-4030-9fe3-8e8d20fa99ee)

Furthermore, by enabling admin to quickly request coverage on specific procedure codes, Health Harbor allows physicians to perform more procedures in fewer visits thus compressing revenue cycles from 4 weeks to 1 week.

### **The Team**

We are Nathan, Alan and Gloria. Nathan comes from an early stage startup, Liminal Sciences, that went public with Hyperfine four years after its inception where he aligned the team on product strategy and built the product as a designer and software engineer. In Alan’s past life, he wrote software for AI systems like speaker identification at Meta’s Portal and prediction of occluded objects at Nuro. As for Gloria, she planned multi-year growth trajectories while at Bain and the Gates Foundation. 

### **The Ask**

1. Customer Intros: Please reach out to us at [founders@healthharbor.co](mailto:founders@healthharbor.co)
   * If you currently call health insurance,
   * If you personally know anyone who complains about calling insurance (including dentists and any other private practice physicians),
   * If you know anyone in private equity firms that manage private practices.
2. Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/health-harbor/)

launches.title: Quill Bills: AI billing that makes doctors more money!
launches.tagline: Transparent, Fast, and Affordable Medical Billing Agency
launches.body:
**The Problem**

Right now, every doctor in the US pays for human billers. Some of them outsource it to a billing agency which charges them anywhere from 2% to _10% of total revenue_. (that’s crazy!)

That on its own is expensive, but there’s also another problem: Since processing bills is expensive, up to **30%** of all claim revenue is denied by health insurance companies, and no follow up is made by the biller to fight it.

**The Solution**

Doctors in the US right now are being charged up to 10% on their bottom line and losing up to 30% of their top line revenue.

Well, we’ve figured out how to fix this problem, by making it a lot cheaper to do billing. We’ve figured out how to do it (nearly) all with AI. We have a team of human billers to do manual checks, but they can process orders of magnitude more claims than a biller doing it manually (which is all of them right now).

This means we can not only charge lower fees, but also we have more bandwidth to fight that 30% denial rate! So we typically end up making doctors more money.

We’ve got decades of billing experience on our team, and are already deployed with clinics and hospitals in the US processing millions of dollars in annual claim revenue.

**Offer for Doctors**

If you or somebody you know is a doctor, we can help them make up to 30% more money every year!

We have a limited offer for the next 10 clinics/hospitals we bring on: **We’ll do your billing as a white-glove service for a flat 1.8% fee (+ no onboarding fee)**. This is way below market price. Just tell them to ask for the YC discount.

**Links**

https://quillbills.com

**Asks**

Please send us any doctors you know! Doctors who own their own practices are our happiest customers.

launches.title: Quill AI: A 10x more efficient equity research platform
launches.tagline: Turn PDFs into spreadsheets, export data with citations, and get up to speed on earnings performance within seconds of release
launches.body:
**tl;dr** We are using LLMs to speed up the equity research process by taking the pain out of working with financial filings.

**Problem 1:** **Pulling tables from SEC filings**

The de-facto current solution is a tool called BamSEC. However, there are a couple of problems with it: a) They don’t provide citation links to their numbers, and b) To merge data from previous filings, you can only do it one table at a time.

Quill solves both these problems. Take a look:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81746&key=user_uploads/1188332/a0ad69cc-e3d1-44e3-be24-11b74b4c7147)

**Problem 2: PDFs → Excel is painful**

This flow normally involves a lot of number-by-number copy-pasting. Quill lets you skip that and turn any PDF into a spreadsheet (extracting all reported numbers and tables) – with citation links for each number.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81746&key=user_uploads/1188332/e60269ce-c233-48e5-a639-b4bf03e5d709)

**Problem 3: Earnings season is extremely hectic**

Every quarter, companies report earnings and investors have to quickly digest the performance, guidance, and Q&A sections of the earnings calls for each of their 20-40 portfolio companies before forming an investment opinion.

Quill lets you digest these sections in an instant. Instead of reading through the raw calls, you get a dashboard that explains the main reported performance and guidance metrics, the key points in management’s commentary, and the key concerns of Wall Street analysts.

Faster workflows mean you can cover more companies per quarter.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=81746&key=user_uploads/1188332/bf27d425-881e-4da3-8c2d-373a4eff5244)

We’ve been working hard on these features and would love to get the word out! If you know people who work in:

* Hedge funds
* Investment banks
* Equity research

We’d love to talk to them!

Our website is <https://quillai.com>

Reach out to us at [founders@quillai.com](mailto:founders@quillai.com)

Best,

Gabriel and Kartik

launches.tagline: Meet Ari, your AI teammate that handles all billing and revenue from Slack
launches.body:
### **TLDR;**

LedgerUp built an AI revenue teammate—[Ari](https://ledgerup.ai/)—to eliminate the multiple tools to juggle to get from “contract signed” to “cash in the bank.” [Ari](https://ledgerup.ai/) integrates with your CRM, automates invoicing, chases payments, and lives in Slack with real-time revenue data. The result? No more manual data entry, overdue payments, scattered data, and hiring FTEs to spend countless hours wasted in back-and-forth amongst different departments.

_Below is an example of CRM → invoice process:_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86964&key=user_uploads/671520/29023983-80d3-4031-9e09-86f2d56ff162)

### **Why does this matter?**

3 out of 4 businesses face payment delays, with the root cause beginning at the invoice creation stage.

**The Pain**: Most companies juggle contract softwares (ex: DocuSign/PDFs), spreadsheets, and a manual billing process riddled with errors, overdue payments, and hours spent data-entering.

**Why It Matters**: These inefficiencies lead to missed revenue, cash flow constraints, and wasted staff time. Founders often feel they need extra full-time staff just to manage invoicing.

### **How does Ari solve this?**

Signature to Revenue, _Automatically_

Ari takes over the moment a contract is signed:

1. Zero-Touch Contract Import: Signature lands → Contract processes → Revenue flows. All automatic, all instant. 
2. Intelligent Revenue Automation: Every signed agreement is automatically billed to its unique billing requirements
3. Real-Time Slack Updates: Approve the final output in Slack and ask questions as needed

While others offer yet another tool to learn, **your AI teammate takes over the moment a contract is signed.**

### **Our ask**

From startups to enterprises, every business faces contract-to-cash challenges. If you know revenue leaders who'd benefit from an AI billing teammate, we'd be grateful for an introduction!

Who we serve well:

* **Finance & Ops Teams:** automating billing operations while maintaining GAAP compliance
* **Founders & Revenue Leaders:** who need clear revenue visibility without the operational overhead
* **CFOs & Controllers:** seeking accurate, real-time revenue data and forecasting 💰
* **Sales & Customer Success:** teams who want to focus on relationships, not invoice follow-ups
* Email us at [founders@ledgerup.ai](mailto:founders@ledgerup.ai)

Better yet if you have a business that has contracts, **try Ari**: [Sign Up Here](https://www.ledgerup.ai/demo) or **Schedule a Call** with us: [Book a Short Call](https://cal.com/joe-ledgerup/15min).

### **Team/Origin Story**

During his years as a finance director for startups, [Joseph](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joseph-johnson-/) lived the revenue operations nightmare firsthand. His days were consumed with juggling dozens of different apps – one for contracts, another for invoicing, yet another for payment tracking, and endless spreadsheets to tie it all together. 

The "_solution_" was always to hire more FTEs to manage the chaos, but that just shifted the burden of wrestling with broken processes to someone else.

Teaming up with his childhood friend [Bailey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bailey-spell-b487ab149/), who had been building AI Agents for the past 2 years, they recognized this wasn't just their problem – it's a universal pain for any company with contracts that need to get paid. 

They're on a mission to liberate founders and finance teams from revenue operations chaos, giving them back the time and clarity needed to focus on what matters most: growing their business.
